dataset: City of Edmonton Open Data, Trees (eecg-fc54)
attribution: City of Edmonton. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Edmonton.
note: Boulevard and open-space trees owned and maintained by the City; not all City-owned trees; private trees not included. No height column: trunk diameter only.
tiles: r_<i>_<j>.json, same grid as t_ tiles (T=2500 m)
fields: r = flat list of x, y (units of 1/Q m from the tile corner, Q=2), h_dm (height, decimetres; -1 none), d_cm (trunk diameter, cm; -1 none)
city_test: inside the zoning overview grown by 40 m (20 m cells); approximate: no city-limit file in the tool
